cues: A scripting language is interpreted line by line as it runs.
On the web there are two places a script can run.
Client side scripts, in JavaScript, are downloaded with the page and run in the visitor's browser.
Server side scripts, like PHP, run on the web server before the page is sent; the visitor only ever sees their output.
